# Product-aware onboarding (S7)

> Historical compatibility note: S11 no longer admits a new standalone S7
> session-v2 flow. Frozen v2 interactions still recover by their persisted
> session version, independent of current flags; all new admission uses the
> full canonical session-v3 chain described in the S8/S11 rollout runbook.

S7 is an additive, default-dark Teacher policy. It asks Learning Planner whether
the exact current Student onboarding state is sufficient to prepare a supported
learning path, then deterministically chooses the next prompt or a terminal
message. Teacher does not create a path, course, or lesson in this flow.

## Rollout and replay

Before S11, `TEACHER_PRODUCT_AWARE_ONBOARDING_ENABLED=false` selected the
legacy session-v1 admission path. Migration 023 ends that split: the flag is
now one member of the full S11 admission chain with dense ordering, canonical
actions, unified coordination, and Planner handoff. If any member is off, a
request without persisted evidence fails before the readiness call or any
other downstream effect; a new request is never admitted as v1 or v2.

Every frozen prompt identifies its immutable policy and session version.
Existing `.v1` prompts continue through policy v1, and an already admitted v2
turn completes as v2 after flags are disabled. Version-3 recovery likewise
continues with handoff semantics. No prompt is reinterpreted from a live
process flag.

## Exact readiness read

Teacher sends `POST /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-readiness` to
Learning Planner with the dedicated Learning Planner `X-Internal-Token`. The
strict request is bounded to 16 KiB:

```json
{
  "schema": "learning-readiness-request.v1",
  "expected_state_ref": {"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 4}
}
```

The request contains no Student profile, graph, mastery, or path projection.
`expected_state_ref` is always present and comes from the exact authoritative
Student state or accepted S3 receipt. A response is at most 64 KiB, has JSON
content type, contains one strict JSON object with no unknown fields, and must
match the expected state reference. Schema, resolver version, scope, result,
one reason code, `executable=false`, `content_status=NOT_CREATED`, goal tuple,
and optional active-path observation are closed and validated together.

A `409`, mismatched reference, malformed response, other non-2xx status, or
operational failure never becomes `no_effect`, never advances the dense cursor,
and never falls back to a guessed product. After a `409` on an accepted turn,
Teacher rereads the exact Student S3 receipt and authoritative state before one
retry. Raw reason codes, graph identifiers, and path/course IDs are never shown.

Readiness is called only from these boundaries:

- on a new product-aware ensure after the authoritative Student state read;
- after an accepted Student S3 effect and before staging the next response;
- on recovery from `student_staged`, after proving the exact accepted receipt.

It is not called before Student CAS, after `no_effect` or a tangent, or after a
response is staged. The post-effect response and transition to
`delivery_pending` commit in one existing S5 transaction.

## Prompt policy v2

`teacher-onboarding-prompt-policy.v2` is immutable and additive; v1 remains
available for frozen-prompt replay. Its core fields are:

- `goal_code=learn_programming`;
- experience `beginner|basic|intermediate|advanced` (`new` is v1 only);
- direction includes `undecided`; exact “Не знаю” meaning maps to it;
- desired stack is asked only for `backend` and accepts exact `go`;
- content language is explicitly asked when missing.

Known stacks, interests, `weekly_minutes`, and pace are deferred. Multiple
high-confidence, exact, low-risk facts from one semantic result may become one
atomic Student S3 patch when provenance and missing-slot rules all pass.
Direction and desired stack remain high-impact and use confirmation when
needed. This adds no LLM invocation: attached free text still uses the one
existing S4 semantic execution, while canonical actions and exact “Не знаю”
remain deterministic. Teacher never calls Student `FinalizeCurrentV1` merely
because Planner reports readiness.

`READY` produces a no-action terminal message saying there is enough data to
prepare `Основы программирования` or `Go backend`, while explicitly saying no
path, course, or lessons were created. `ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS` preserves the
existing path with no card, action, or mutation. Clarification selects one
actual missing core field from the Planner reason and authoritative Student
state. Unsupported combinations receive an honest deterministic correction
prompt; unavailable published graph or invalid output fails closed.

## Durable prompt closure

Migration `020_teacher_product_aware_onboarding_interaction_close` adds the
honest immutable interaction state `closed`, exact reason
`planning_ready|active_path_exists`, and `closed_at`. Active v1 is atomically
superseded when an exact v2 successor prompt is admitted. Terminal ensure locks
and closes the sole active prompt; it never steals a reserved or action-claimed
prompt and instead reports that current prompt as collecting. Canonical receipt
claim and terminal close share the same per-Dialog transaction fence, so exactly
one wins. New stale clicks fail before Dialog materialization or Student CAS;
an already materialized exact receipt remains replayable. Rollback requires a
drain and fails closed while any terminal-close evidence or canonical
`claimed|applied|materialized` prompt-effect receipt exists.

For a coordinator terminal response, the durable accepted Student effect and
empty staged UI identify `close_terminal` after a crash. A response-only tangent
or `no_effect` instead identifies `preserve_prompt`. Delivery therefore closes
the reserved prompt for `PLANNING_READY`/`ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS`, but keeps a prompt
active only for a genuine tangent/no-effect reply.

## Browser session and action result

While S7 is enabled, ensure returns `teacher-onboarding-session.v2`:

```json
{
  "schema": "teacher-onboarding-session.v2",
  "dialog_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000",
  "status": "COLLECTING",
  "phase": "DETERMINING_START",
  "state_ref": {"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 4},
  "current_prompt": {"message_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "message_version": 1}
}
```

Status is `COLLECTING|PLANNING_READY|ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS`; phase is
`GETTING_ACQUAINTED|DETERMINING_START|PREPARING_PATH|READY_TO_START`.
`current_prompt` exists only for `COLLECTING`. Terminal sessions carry
`terminal.kind`; `PLANNING_READY` also carries the safe `display_name`, while
`ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS` carries no path identity.

The canonical endpoint keeps `assistant-ui-action-result.v2` unchanged:

```json
{
  "schema": "assistant-ui-action-result.v2",
  "mode": "canonical",
  "materialized": true,
  "replayed": false,
  "canonical_student_message_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
}
```

This means only that the canonical Student message is materialized and its v2
turn is pending/completing through the dense coordinator. It does not claim
Student onboarding or product planning completed. Correlation uses the request
Dialog, frozen prompt message/version, idempotency key, and returned canonical
Student message ID.

S8 optionally replaces only the `PLANNING_READY` boundary with a durable,
non-executable Planner admission. Its separate flag, ledger, recovery rules,
and `teacher-onboarding-session.v3` projection are documented in
[Durable onboarding Planner handoff S8](durable-onboarding-handoff.md).
